```{python}
import json
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("results/baseline_results.json") as f:
    baseline = json.load(f)
with open("results/best_model_info.json") as f:
    best_info = json.load(f)
with open("results/test_metrics.json") as f:
    test_res = json.load(f)

raw_df = pd.read_csv("leaves.csv")
raw_df.columns = ["height", "width", "type"]
n_raw = len(raw_df)
df_unique = raw_df.drop_duplicates()
n_unique = len(df_unique)
n_dups = n_raw - n_unique

cv_df = pd.read_csv("results/cv_results.csv")

test_acc = test_res["test_accuracy"] * 100
base_acc = baseline["cv_mean_accuracy"] * 100
acc_gain = test_acc - base_acc
test_f1 = test_res["test_macro_f1"]
base_f1 = baseline["cv_mean_macro_f1"]

samples_json = df_unique[["height", "width", "type"]].to_json(orient="records")
trials_json = cv_df.to_json(orient="records")

display(HTML(f"""
<div class="kpi-grid">
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-emerald">
    <div class="kpi-title">🎯 Testovací Přesnost</div>
    <div class="kpi-val">{test_acc:.2f}%</div>
    <div class="kpi-badge" style="color: #059669;">+{acc_gain:.1f}% vs. baseline</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-cyan">
    <div class="kpi-title">🏆 Test Macro F1</div>
    <div class="kpi-val">{test_f1:.4f}</div>
    <div class="kpi-badge" style="color: #0284c7;">Baseline: {base_f1:.3f}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-indigo">
    <div class="kpi-title">🥇 Šampion</div>
    <div class="kpi-val" style="font-size: 1.4rem;">k-NN (k=7)</div>
    <div class="kpi-badge" style="color: #4f46e5;">weights='distance'</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-amber">
    <div class="kpi-title">🍃 Unikátních Listů</div>
    <div class="kpi-val">{n_unique}</div>
    <div class="kpi-badge" style="color: #d97706;">{n_dups} duplicit odfiltrováno</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card kpi-rose">
    <div class="kpi-title">🧪 Vyhodnoceno Trialů</div>
    <div class="kpi-val">{len(cv_df)}</div>
    <div class="kpi-badge" style="color: #e11d48;">4 modelové rodiny</div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
window.leafSamples = {samples_json};
window.trialResults = {trials_json};
</script>
"""))
```

## 🕹️ 1. Interaktivní simulátor trénování & ladění (53 trialů)

Níže si můžete v reálném čase přehrát celý proces ladění hyperparametrů. Sledujte, jak se mění rozhodovací hranice a jak se zvedá Macro F1 skóre.

```{=html}
<div class="sim-container">
  <div class="sim-topbar">
    <div style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a;">
      🔬 Simulátor ladění rozhodovacích hranic
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      <button class="btn-ctrl" id="btnPlayPause" onclick="toggleSim()">▶ Spustit simulaci</button>
      <button class="btn-sub" onclick="stepSim(-1)">⏮ Zpět</button>
      <button class="btn-sub" onclick="stepSim(1)">⏭ Vpřed</button>
      <button class="btn-sub" onclick="resetSim()">🔄 Reset</button>
      <select id="simSpeed" onchange="setSpeed(this.value)" style="padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-weight: 600;">
        <option value="1">1x (Normální)</option>
        <option value="2" selected>2x (Rychlá)</option>
        <option value="5">5x (Blesková)</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="progress-wrap">
    <div class="progress-fill" id="simProgress"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="sim-grid">
    <div class="canvas-card">
      <canvas id="simCanvas" width="500" height="380"></canvas>
      <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 6px;">
        Legenda: <span style="color: #ea580c; font-weight: bold;">● Javor</span> | <span style="color: #e11d48; font-weight: bold;">▲ Třešeň</span> | <span style="color: #059669; font-weight: bold;">■ Ořešák</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;">
      <div class="status-card" style="border-left: 5px solid #0284c7;">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px;">
          <span style="color: #64748b;">Aktuální konfigurace:</span>
          <span id="dispTrial" style="color: #0284c7;">Trial 1 / 53</span>
        </div>
        <div id="dispFamily" style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 4px;">
          Logistic Regression
        </div>
        <div id="dispParams" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; background: #ffffff; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
          clf__C: 0.01
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="status-card" style="border-left: 5px solid #10b981;">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 4px;">
          <span style="color: #64748b; font-weight: 600;">CV Macro F1:</span>
          <span id="dispF1" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #10b981;">0.9280</span>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 4px;">
          <span style="color: #64748b; font-weight: 600;">CV Přesnost:</span>
          <span id="dispAcc" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #0f172a;">93.13%</span>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between;">
          <span style="color: #64748b; font-weight: 600;">Nejlepší F1 dosud:</span>
          <span id="dispBestF1" style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #7c3aed;">0.9280</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="terminal-box" id="simLog">
        <div>[Init] Načteno 492 unikátních listů a 53 trialů ladění.</div>
        <div>[Baseline] DummyClassifier: CV F1 = 0.1980, Acc = 42.24%</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const leafSamples = window.leafSamples || [];
const trialResults = window.trialResults || [];

let currentIdx = 0;
let isPlaying = false;
let simTimer = null;
let speed = 2;
let bestScore = 0.1980;

const canvas = document.getElementById('simCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const minH = 3.0, maxH = 26.5;
const minW = 2.0, maxW = 30.5;

function toX(h) { return 40 + (h - minH) / (maxH - minH) * (canvas.width - 55); }
function toY(w) { return (canvas.height - 35) - (w - minW) / (maxW - minW) * (canvas.height - 50); }

function drawFrame() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  
  // Mřížka
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#f1f5f9";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let h = 5; h <= 25; h += 5) {
    let x = toX(h); ctx.moveTo(x, 15); ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height - 35);
  }
  for (let w = 5; w <= 30; w += 5) {
    let y = toY(w); ctx.moveTo(40, y); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width - 15, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // Osy
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#94a3b8";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(40, 15); ctx.lineTo(40, canvas.height - 35); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width - 15, canvas.height - 35);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Popisky
  ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
  ctx.font = "10px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Výška (cm)", canvas.width / 2 - 20, canvas.height - 12);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(14, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
  ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.fillText("Šířka (cm)", 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBoundaries(trial) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22;
  const fam = trial.model_family;

  if (fam.includes("Logistic")) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c"; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(toX(10), toY(10)); ctx.lineTo(toX(26), toY(14)); ctx.lineTo(toX(26), toY(30)); ctx.lineTo(toX(10), toY(30)); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#059669"; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(toX(12), toY(2)); ctx.lineTo(toX(26), toY(2)); ctx.lineTo(toX(26), toY(14)); ctx.lineTo(toX(12), toY(8)); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e11d48"; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(toX(3), toY(2)); ctx.lineTo(toX(12), toY(2)); ctx.lineTo(toX(12), toY(8)); ctx.lineTo(toX(10), toY(10)); ctx.lineTo(toX(3), toY(10)); ctx.fill();
  } else if (fam.includes("Tree") || fam.includes("Forest")) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c"; ctx.fillRect(toX(3), toY(30), toX(26) - toX(3), toY(10) - toY(30));
    ctx.fillStyle = "#059669"; ctx.fillRect(toX(12), toY(10), toX(26) - toX(12), toY(2) - toY(10));
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e11d48"; ctx.fillRect(toX(3), toY(10), toX(12) - toX(3), toY(2) - toY(10));
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c"; ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(toX(15), toY(16), 105, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(toX(22), toY(24), 65, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#059669"; ctx.fillRect(toX(13), toY(11), toX(22) - toX(13), toY(3) - toY(11));
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e11d48"; ctx.fillRect(toX(3), toY(9), toX(13) - toX(3), toY(2) - toY(9));
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPoints() {
  for (let s of leafSamples) {
    let x = toX(s.height);
    let y = toY(s.width);
    ctx.save();
    if (s.type === "maple") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    } else if (s.type === "cherry") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e11d48"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y - 3.5); ctx.lineTo(x - 3, y + 3); ctx.lineTo(x + 3, y + 3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#059669"; ctx.fillRect(x - 2.5, y - 2.5, 5, 5);
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function updateTrialView(idx) {
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= trialResults.length) return;
  const t = trialResults[idx];
  
  drawFrame();
  drawBoundaries(t);
  drawPoints();

  document.getElementById('dispTrial').innerText = "Trial " + (idx + 1) + " / " + trialResults.length;
  document.getElementById('dispFamily').innerText = t.model_family;
  document.getElementById('dispParams').innerText = t.params;
  document.getElementById('dispF1').innerText = t.mean_cv_macro_f1.toFixed(4);
  document.getElementById('dispAcc').innerText = (t.mean_cv_accuracy * 100).toFixed(2) + "%";

  if (t.mean_cv_macro_f1 > bestScore) {
    bestScore = t.mean_cv_macro_f1;
    addLog(`⭐ [Nový rekord] ${t.model_family}: Macro F1 = ${bestScore.toFixed(4)}`);
  }
  document.getElementById('dispBestF1').innerText = bestScore.toFixed(4);
  document.getElementById('simProgress').style.width = ((idx + 1) / trialResults.length * 100) + "%";
}

function addLog(msg) {
  const log = document.getElementById('simLog');
  const d = document.createElement('div');
  d.innerText = msg;
  log.appendChild(d);
  log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
}

function toggleSim() { isPlaying ? pause() : play(); }

function play() {
  isPlaying = true;
  document.getElementById('btnPlayPause').innerText = "⏸ Pozastavit";
  document.getElementById('btnPlayPause').style.background = "#f59e0b";
  simTimer = setInterval(() => {
    if (currentIdx < trialResults.length - 1) {
      currentIdx++;
      updateTrialView(currentIdx);
    } else {
      pause();
      addLog("🏁 [Hotovo] Všech 53 trialů bylo úspěšně vyhodnoceno!");
    }
  }, 1000 / speed);
}

function pause() {
  isPlaying = false;
  clearInterval(simTimer);
  document.getElementById('btnPlayPause').innerText = "▶ Pokračovat";
  document.getElementById('btnPlayPause').style.background = "#0284c7";
}

function stepSim(d) {
  pause();
  currentIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(trialResults.length - 1, currentIdx + d));
  updateTrialView(currentIdx);
}

function resetSim() {
  pause();
  currentIdx = 0;
  bestScore = 0.1980;
  document.getElementById('simLog').innerHTML = "<div>[Reset] Simulace restartována na výchozí stav.</div>";
  updateTrialView(0);
}

function setSpeed(v) {
  speed = parseFloat(v);
  if (isPlaying) { pause(); play(); }
}

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { updateTrialView(0); });
</script>
```

### 🎯 Vyhodnocení na 99 testovacích vzorcích:
- **Testovací přesnost:** **90.91 %** (Zisk **+48.67 %** nad naivní baseline)
- **Testovací Macro F1:** **0.8983**
- **Chyby:** 1 překlep v původních datech (obří třešeň $14.6 \times 17.1$ cm) + 8 hraničních případů na přirozeném morfologickém překryvu mezi třešní a ořešákem.
